answer: Special Ops turncoat rule: pay anyone who proves two keys share a master. Any address may post a joint confession signed by two or more identity keys; those identities freeze, half their locked vesting pay goes to the confessor's fresh address and half is burned. An honest agent holds one key, so it has nothing to sell. A farm's grove of 1,000 keys lives on servers, scripts and hired hands, and each one is a beacon for a payout bigger than its wage. The operator must guard an atlas of insiders forever, and one leak costs the whole vested pot.
